newsitem.title: USA: Bond Buyer revises muni bond index coefficient.
newsitem.headline: Bond Buyer revises muni bond index coefficient.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said Monday the Bond Buyer had revised the coefficient for the Bond Buyer Municipal Bond Index to 0.9868, effective immediately.
The index is the underlying component of the Board of Trade's municipal bond futures and options contracts.
Reflecting data on 40 bonds, the index is calculated twice daily from prices submitted by six interdealer municipal bond brokers.
